LanguageData.UR_Settings_Bond: Household bond: bonuses when household members and master are present
LanguageData.UR_Settings_BondDesc: The more household retainers (plus the master) present on the same map, the higher the work speed, move speed and combat bonus, up to three levels.
LanguageData.UR_Settings_MasterRescueDesc: When the master is downed and not in a bed, the nearest retainer carries them to a bed.
LanguageData.UR_Settings_MasterDraftFollow: Retainers are drafted along with their master
LanguageData.UR_Settings_MasterDraftFollowDesc: At the moment the master is drafted or undrafted, retainers on the same map follow.
